channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Brought Venezuelan Gold to the U.S., but Refiners Won’t Touch It
item.description: The administration is brokering deals in a notoriously corrupt industry, including one with a company that the United States deems a security threat.

item.title: NPR: Prosecutors are reexamining a Cornell fraternity rape case. Here's what we know
item.description: New York prosecutors are reopening an investigation into an alleged rape case at Cornell University in 2024. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit against seven members of Chi Phi fraternity.

item.title: BBC News: What we know about RAF Fairford counter-terror probe
item.description: Five men have been arrested as counter-terror police lead an investigation into a major incident near the airbase.

item.title: The Guardian: Gone in 90 seconds: an ‘invisibilized’ ICE is arresting more people than ever
item.description: After public backlash, the Trump administration changed its tactics from ‘siege’ to ‘soft feet’. Now, ICE is everywhere Continue reading...

item.title: Al Jazeera: UK police release suspects on bail after RAF arrests, investigation ongoing
item.description: British police officials say that suspects arrested over a 'terror' incident at a RAF base were released on police bail.

item.title: Ars Technica: F1 in Azerbaijan: That was almost a close-run thing
item.description: Kimi Antonelli could not repeat his Monza magic after a crash in qualifying.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Who Killed Paulina Borsook’s Career?
item.description: A quarter-century ago, Borsook published a wildly prophetic, penetrating book about Silicon Valley called Cyberselfish. Then she disappeared.

item.title: WIRED Science: Space Lasers Are About to Get Their First Real Test Generating Energy
item.description: Startup Star Catcher is launching a system that, if successful, would be the first time energy has been beamed between two separate spacecraft.

item.title: WIRED Business: AI Agents Are About to Flood the Workforce. No One’s Ready for It
item.description: Your next coworker might well be an AI agent—and will require a whole new model of workplace interactions.

item.title: The New Yorker: How Paweł Pawlikowski Learned to Film Europe’s Fractures
item.description: The Polish director has made a career out of examining the mysteries of borders, both spiritual and political.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: What We Know About the ‘Cornell Seven’ Rape Case
item.description: A Jane Doe sued Cornell and seven current and former students alleging the school failed to protect her after she was raped at a frat house.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: A One-Bedroom With Lovely Casement Windows in Brooklyn Heights for $765,000
item.description: And a West Village one-bedroom duplex with a bathroom on each floor.
